name: Aphelion of Pluto
description:
[term:eclipse][blue]Eclipses[/blue][/term] Cerberus. It instead starts as the sword Charon, which charges over 9 attacks, then transforms into [red]P[/red][gold]l[/gold][yellow]u[/yellow][gray]t[/gray][aqua]o[/aqua], a loaded crossbow with the mythical spread enchantment Cryovolcano🌟. Pluto fires once, then reforms into Charon.

  • Charon: 4.5 Attack Damage, 2 Attack Speed

  • Cryovolcano: Shots fire a 9-block long and 4.5-block wide cylinder for 9 damage, applying 9 seconds of freezing and burning.
